SELECT 
  r."REGION_NAME" AS "REGION_NAME",
  COUNT(DISTINCT c."CUST_ID") AS "AT_RISK_CUSTOMERS"
FROM 
  "SAI_SEM_LAB"."REGIONS" r
  INNER JOIN "SAI_SEM_LAB"."CUSTOMERS" c ON c."REGION_ID" = r."REGION_ID"
WHERE 
  c."CUST_ID" IN (
    SELECT 
      o."CUST_ID"
    FROM 
      "SAI_SEM_LAB"."ORDERS" o
    WHERE 
      o."ORDER_DATE" >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -3)
    GROUP BY 
      o."CUST_ID"
    HAVING 
      SUM(CASE WHEN o."STATUS" = 'SHIPPED' THEN o."GROSS_AMT" - o."DISC_AMT" ELSE 0 END) > 50000
      AND SUM(CASE WHEN o."STATUS" = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 
      1
    FROM 
      "SAI_SEM_LAB"."TICKETS" t
    WHERE 
      t."CUST_ID" = c."CUST_ID"
      AND t."ESCL_FLAG" = 'Y'
      AND t."STATUS" != 'CLOSED'
  )
GROUP BY 
  r."REGION_NAME"
ORDER BY 
  r."REGION_NAME"

SELECT 
  r."REGION_NAME" AS "REGION_NAME",
  COUNT(DISTINCT c."CUST_ID") AS "AT_RISK_CUSTOMERS"
FROM 
  "SAI_SEM_LAB"."REGIONS" r
  JOIN "SAI_SEM_LAB"."CUSTOMERS" c ON r."REGION_ID" = c."REGION_ID"
WHERE 
  c."CUST_ID" IN (
    SELECT 
      o."CUST_ID"
    FROM 
      "SAI_SEM_LAB"."ORDERS" o
    WHERE 
      o."ORDER_DATE" >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -3)
      AND o."STATUS" = 'SHIPPED'
    GROUP BY 
      o."CUST_ID"
    HAVING 
      SUM(o."GROSS_AMT" - o."DISC_AMT") > 50000
  )
  AND c."CUST_ID" NOT IN (
    SELECT 
      o."CUST_ID"
    FROM 
      "SAI_SEM_LAB"."ORDERS" o
    WHERE 
      o."ORDER_DATE" >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -3)
      AND o."STATUS" != 'CANCELLED'
    GROUP BY 
      o."CUST_ID"
  )
  AND c."CUST_ID" IN (
    SELECT 
      t."CUST_ID"
    FROM 
      "SAI_SEM_LAB"."TICKETS" t
    WHERE 
      t."ESCL_FLAG" = 'Y'
      AND t."STATUS" != 'CLOSED'
  )
GROUP BY 
  r."REGION_NAME"
ORDER BY 
  r."REGION_NAME"
